sections.text:
Work 
to be Carried Out
التفكيك
To disassemble the pump the following procedures are recommended:
WARNING

Make sure that the main circuit breaker of the pump electric motor is 
 locked open.
Make sure that the discharge butterfly valve is closed.
Empty the suction basin of the pump.

Make the scaffold ready in the basin; unscrew and take away the bolts 
 (41) with their nuts and washers which connect the discharge elbow of 
 the pump to the discharge piping.

Disconnect the thrust bearing oil cooling water pipe at the relevant 
 flanges (42)

Disconnect the cooling and lube water to gland and guide bearing at the 
 relevant flanges (43)
Disconnect the wires at the junction box (38)

Fix the special tool (36) on to its suitable site on the pump shaft (see 
 Fig.5)

Fix its stay bolts to the pump bracket to prevent shaft movements during 
 next steps.

Take 
 off the flexible coupling with the following procedure (see Fig. 6)

sections.text: Guide Bearings

Inspect upper and lower bearings (rubber lined) and 
 relevant bearing sleeves
Check both surfaces for signs of galling.

Check the radial bearing clearances, if these values exceed the max. 
 permissible ones (see Table 2) , new bearings should be mounted to reset an 
 acceptable clearance between nominal and max. value; replacement of the 
 shaft protecting sleeve shall be carried out only in presence of extensive 
 damages.
